subject: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)
body:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Jan 18, 2026 at 9:04 AM PST
Subject: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)

Hey all —

We’re in the last lap for the docs refresh. I’d like to run a tight review loop on the three user-facing pages + troubleshooting callouts:

- Streaming responses (PR 901)
- Tool calling (PR 902)
- Structured output (PR 903)
- Nav/IA change grouping the section (PR 904)

Asks:
1) Wei: editorial/clarity pass (headings, terminology, warnings). Please focus on “event semantics” language and anything that reads ambiguous for first-time readers.
2) Ibrahim: confirm the stream event naming + delta semantics we’re describing match the gateway behavior (incl. partial tool args and final response object).
3) Monica/Connor: sanity check release timing. We want docs deploy to align with SDK patch releases so copy/paste works.

I attached the current editorial checklist we’ve been using (and a doc with suggested copy edits if you prefer to comment there).

Goal is to have approvals by EOD Tue (1/20) so we can get this into the weekly docs deploy window.

Thanks,
Elliot
—
Elliot Price
Docs Program Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachment] docs-refresh-editorial-checklist.pdf
[Attachment] streaming-tools-structured-output-copyedits.docx


From: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Jan 18, 2026 at 11:19 AM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)

Reviewed PR 901/902/903 quickly. Overall direction is solid; a few editorial items to tighten up:

Streaming (901):
- Please define “delta” the first time it appears. Suggest: “A delta is an incremental update; you must accumulate deltas to reconstruct the full text/tool arguments.”
- Add an explicit note that stream event order is not guaranteed across network retries; readers should treat the final response as source of truth for totals.
- The troubleshooting callout about proxy buffering is good, but I’d move it immediately after the first streaming code block so it’s seen.

Tools (902):
- Terminology: pick “tool calling” consistently; avoid “function calling” except where we mention it as legacy/alias.
- The “partial args” note is critical. I’d make it a warning callout and include one concrete example sentence: “Don’t JSON.parse() tool args on each delta.”
- The parallel tools section: add a single line about concurrency control (limit to N concurrent tool executions), since customers will copy this.

Structured output (903):
- Please state that schema validation should happen on the *final* assistant message content (or structured payload), not on token deltas.
- Retry strategy section: I think it’s okay to keep (we keep getting tickets), but tighten the language to avoid sounding like we recommend infinite retries.

Nav/IA (904):
- +1 on grouping. Please ensure cross-links from quickstarts still work (we’ve had broken anchors when headings change).

I left inline suggestions on 901 and 902; 903 I commented mainly on the intro.

Wei


From: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Jan 18, 2026 at 1:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)

+1 to Wei’s notes.

On event semantics:
- The wording in 901 about “final response” should explicitly say: the SDK may deliver a final aggregated object/event at the end of the stream (depending on language), and that’s where the complete message + any tool calls are reliably available.
- Tool-call deltas: The gateway sends incremental tool_call arguments; JSON will often be incomplete until the tool_call is finished. Docs should recommend: accumulate into a buffer keyed by tool_call_id, parse only when the tool_call is marked complete OR at end-of-stream.
- If we mention “resume”: we should be careful. We don’t have a true server-side resume token today. We can recommend retrying the request idempotently when safe, but not claim we can resume from an offset.

I’ll double-check the phrasing against the gateway tests in the validation PR, but the general story is correct.

Also: if we’re going to keep the line “treat final response as source of truth”, please avoid implying the stream is unordered. It is ordered when the connection is healthy; it’s “incomplete/terminated” that bites people. Suggest wording: “If the stream disconnects, rely on your accumulated state + handle missing completion; consider a retry.”

Ibrahim


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 9:42 AM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)

Thanks — this is exactly the level of specificity we needed.

Edits I’m making today:
- Add explicit “what is a delta” definition + “accumulate then finalize” framing (901)
- Change “stream order not guaranteed” to “stream may terminate; use final aggregated response when available; treat disconnect as incomplete” (901)
- Convert “partial args” into a warning callout + add “don’t parse on every chunk” sentence (902)
- Add one line on concurrency limits for parallel tools (902)
- Structured output: clarify validate on final payload + cap retries (e.g., 1–2 retries with stricter instruction) (903)
- Cross-link audit after IA changes (904)

Verification ask:
Can you both confirm the code blocks are aligned with the canonical examples before we merge? I’m specifically worried about:
1) The streaming loop pattern (capturing final message, not dropping it)
2) Tool args aggregation keyed by tool_call_id (not by index)
3) Structured output: schema example + error handling text not diverging from what SDKs actually do

If easier, please just sanity-check the updated code blocks on the PR previews once I push changes today.

Re release timing: Connor — I’ll defer to you/Monica on whether we can ship docs first or need to wait for SDK patch releases to hit.

Elliot


From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 2:28 PM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)

On timing:
- Strong preference to deploy docs *after* SDK patch releases are live (or same day) to avoid another round of “docs say X but SDK does Y” tickets.
- Current plan (tentative): SDK patch releases Tue evening -> docs deploy Wed morning.

If we can’t hit that, I’d rather hold docs than ship ahead.

Can you add a small version note on each page like “Requires SDK >= <version> for these examples” (where relevant)? Even if we ship together, it helps folks who are pinned.

Connor


From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 20, 2026 at 10:11 AM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)

Agree with Connor — ship docs when SDK patches are out.

Elliot: please add the version requirement callout where it’s not backwards compatible (especially the streaming iteration patterns + tool delta aggregation).

Ibrahim: once Elliot updates the language around disconnects vs “unordered”, can you give a quick yes/no that it matches gateway semantics? (No need for a long write-up.)

Wei: thank you for the editorial pass. Please confirm the updated callouts are not overly alarming (we want honest troubleshooting without making streaming look fragile).

Monica


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 20, 2026 at 4:37 PM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review loop: Streaming + Tools + Structured Output pages (final editorial pass + verification + release timing)

Update: I pushed revisions to 901/902/903 and added version callouts (kept them short; only where patterns require newer SDK behavior).

Summary of changes:
- Streaming: clarified ordered stream semantics; added “disconnect => incomplete” handling; moved proxy buffering troubleshooting earlier.
- Tools: warning callout for partial args; explicitly says to buffer by tool_call_id; added concurrency limit note.
- Structured output: validation on final payload; retry strategy capped (1–2) with explicit failure mode guidance.

Can you do a final “OK to merge” on the PRs tonight?

- If all approvals are in by ~7pm PT, I’ll coordinate merge order with Connor and queue for post-SDK-release deploy.
- If anything looks off, I’ll hold merges and we’ll slip the deploy rather than ship drift.

Links:
- Streaming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/901
- Tools: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/902
- Structured output: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/903
- IA/Nav: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/904

Elliot
